text: Hanya Yanagihara's A Little Life was banned from distribution in Belarus in 2025, together with her later novel To Paradise, citing potential harm to national interests. The decision, dated 24 January 2025, added the book to the Official List of Publications Harmful to National Interests of the Ministry of Information, as documented by PEN Belarus. In Russia, distribution of the novel was restricted after the November 2023 Supreme Court ruling that designated the "international LGBT movement" as extremist, and Russian retailers pulled or restricted it.
